params.message:
Netwerk is the map, Bespreken the conversation

Both pages showed who carries what, with a bar and a filter: Netwerk
counted relations ("Wie draagt de relatie vandaag", with how many the
table had noted), Bespreken counted notes ("Wie weet het vandaag"), and
the difference did not show on screen.

Netwerk keeps the graph, the list and its filters, carrier included;
the carrier card with the table's progress goes. Bespreken keeps the
agenda and what was told: the progress is one line above the agenda,
now also saying how many relations only the owner carries, and the
four tiles and the carrier bar become two selects in the filter row.

The context panel stays the same wherever a relation opens.
